summaries.baseline:
**Al-Ittihad FC Triumph in Dominant Display Against Auckland City**

In a commanding performance at King Abdullah Sports City, Al-Ittihad FC dispatched Auckland City with a 3-0 victory to advance in the FIFA Club World Cup 2024. The Saudi champions showcased their attacking prowess and defensive solidity, much to the delight of the home fans.

From the outset, Al-Ittihad seized control, dictating the pace and flow of the match. Their relentless pressure culminated in the opening goal during the first half, setting the tone for what would be a difficult evening for Auckland City. Despite a valiant effort, the New Zealand side struggled to contain their opponents and failed to breach the host's robust defenses.

As the match progressed, Al-Ittihad continued to exhibit clinical finishing and precise passing, adding two more goals to their tally and sealing a comprehensive victory. The win underscores Al-Ittihad's intentions as serious contenders in this prestigious global competition.

With this decisive triumph, Al-Ittihad not only advances to the next stage but also sends a clear message to their competitors, proving that they are a force to be reckoned with on the international stage.
summaries.match_report: Al-Ittihad FC secured a commanding 3-0 victory over Auckland City in the FIFA Club World Cup 2024 at King Abdullah Sports City. The home side opened the scoring in the 18th minute when Mohamed Hamdy slotted a precise finish past the Auckland City goalkeeper. Just before halftime, Igor Coronado doubled Al-Ittihad's lead with a well-placed shot in the 42nd minute. Auckland City struggled to create significant scoring opportunities and were unable to break through the home team's defense. Al-Ittihad sealed the triumph with a third goal in the 76th minute, courtesy of Karim Benzema, who calmly converted a chance following a well-executed team move. Despite Auckland City's efforts to regroup, they were unable to overcome the deficit as Al-Ittihad held firm to secure the win and advance in the tournament.

Haroune Camara, coming off the bench, made an immediate impact by heading in a corner delivered by Coronado, who recorded his second assist of the match.
